# Rust publisher compatibility fixture

These immutable index files were generated by the Rust asset publisher from three synthetic assets: a chart in `startapp`, an uppercase chart name in `ondemand`, and a mixed-case character thumbnail. They are intentionally kept byte-for-byte: the consumer validates the original SHA-256 digests and region revision across languages.

Only the current pointer, asset shards, and BPM blob are present. The raw assets are deliberately absent, so tests also verify that authoritative existence/negative lookup and BPM lookup need no asset-body reads. Both `assetindex` and `music` tests use this fixture; no temporary directory or external service is required.
